manifest.title: Write a document (to your style)
manifest.description: Writes the document you ask for, from an article, paper, regulation or manual up to a whole book, to the folder's style (STYLE.md and chaff.yaml). After a person checks the brief and the outline, it writes one part (chapter) at a time and checks each part with chaff. Sentences taken from your sources stay as quotes, and are checked to be in the original.

kind.label: What kind of document is it?
kind.why: This decides how the outline is built and how it is checked

topic.label: What will it be about?
topic.why: This is where the brief and the outline start

audience.label: Who will read it, and what should they be able to do after reading it?
audience.why: This decides what to write and what to leave out

points.label: Things that must be in it (one per line)
points.why: These become the main points of the brief, and are checked to be in it when the writing is done

sources.label: Sources to refer to (one file, folder or URL per line; leave empty if none)
sources.why: Facts are taken from these, and sentences taken from them are checked, as quotes, to be in the original

length.label: Length
length.why: This decides how it is split into parts

options.短い（2,000 字・800 語くらいまで）: Short (up to about 2,000 Japanese characters or 800 words)
options.中くらい（8,000 字・3,000 語くらいまで）: Medium (up to about 8,000 Japanese characters or 3,000 words)

style.label: Which style should it follow?
style.why: If this folder has the STYLE.md and chaff.yaml that "Make a style" wrote, it is written to them

brief.title: Write the brief
brief.description: Puts the purpose, the readers, the main points, the facts to take from the sources and what is not yet decided into a brief, and gathers the sources.

outline.title: Decide the outline
outline.description: For each part (chapter or section), decides the file to write, the points to put in, and the length.

draft.title: Write one part at a time
draft.description: Writes the parts of the outline one at a time, and checks that chaff finds nothing against the style and that sentences taken from the sources are in the original. Repeats while any are left.

report.title: Report
report.description: What was written, what was checked, and what could not be fully checked.

tebiki.title: Write a guide for new staff
tebiki.description: Writes a short guide to "what to do on your first day", after checking the brief and the outline. No sample document is needed. Run the "Make a style" example in the same folder first, and it is written to that style.
